description: Repair the operational controller in solution.py for the ingestion deployment. Read the API contract and deployment context; execute a safe complete workflow through run(api). This controller may start with durable work already completed. Resume from the observable entry state, safely finish every recovery case and any required post-cleanup audit.

files.README.md:
Implement run(api). api.inspect('state') returns detached current state, costing one unit. api.apply(operation) atomically executes a documented operation and returns updated state. A failed precondition or safety invariant invalidates the case, even if caught. Do not access API internals. Different valid complete plans are accepted.

Process and acknowledge an event with durable application and delivery, without applying a replay twice. Use the configured transaction and sink semantics. An acknowledged event must already be durable and delivered. Leave no active lease or transaction.

Operations (all requires predicates must hold):
- claim: requires {"leased": false}; effects {"leased": true}; cost 1.
- begin: requires {"transactional": true, "leased": true, "applied": false}; effects {"transaction": true}; cost 1.
- apply_transactional: requires {"transaction": true, "applied": false}; effects {"applied": true}; cost 1.
- apply_direct: requires {"transactional": false, "leased": true, "applied": false}; effects {"applied": true}; cost 1.
- stage_outbox: requires {"applied": true, "committed": false}; effects {"outbox": true}; cost 1.
- commit_transaction: requires {"transaction": true, "outbox": true}; effects {"committed": true, "transaction": false}; cost 1.
- persist_direct: requires {"transactional": false, "outbox": true}; effects {"committed": true}; cost 1.
- deliver_idempotently: requires {"committed": true, "deduplicating_sink": true}; effects {"delivered": true}; cost 1.
- check_delivery_receipt: requires {"committed": true}; effects {"receipt_checked": true}; cost 1.
- deliver_once: requires {"committed": true, "receipt_checked": true, "delivered": false}; effects {"delivered": true}; cost 1.
- acknowledge: requires {"leased": true, "committed": true, "delivered": true}; effects {"acknowledged": true}; cost 1.
- release_lease: requires {"acknowledged": true}; effects {"leased": false}; cost 1.
- record_ingestion_audit: requires {"committed": true, "delivered": true, "acknowledged": true, "leased": false, "transaction": false, "audited": false}; effects {"audited": true}; cost 1.

Safety invariants:
[]
Completion obligations:
{
  "durability": {
    "applied": true,
    "committed": true,
    "outbox": true
  },
  "delivery": {
    "delivered": true,
    "acknowledged": true
  },
  "cleanup": {
    "leased": false,
    "transaction": false
  },
  "post_cleanup_audit": {
    "audited": true
  }
}
Actual initial durable state (overrides historical defaults):
{
  "transactional": true,
  "deduplicating_sink": false,
  "replayed": false,
  "leased": true,
  "transaction": false,
  "applied": true,
  "outbox": true,
  "committed": true,
  "delivered": false,
  "receipt_checked": false,
  "acknowledged": false,
  "audit_required": true,
  "audited": false
}
Process recovery contract: the supervisor may kill the process after any API operation and invoke run(api) with fresh local variables. Completed external service effects persist. An open ingestion transaction rolls back transaction/applied/outbox on death. Reconstruct progress from api.inspect('state'); never suppress process death. Safely complete without faults and under up to two interruptions, including after the last operation. Total operation budget, including restart inspections: 30. An audit, when required, must be recorded after cleanup and itself tolerate restart.

crash_semantics: atomic external effects persist; open transactions roll back; fresh locals
